MESSAGE_TEMPLATES_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: Create and manage WhatsApp message templates. Every template must be approved by Meta before it can be sent to customers.
MESSAGE_TEMPLATES_MGMT.NO_WHATSAPP_INBOX: Connect a WhatsApp Cloud API inbox to create and manage message templates.
MESSAGE_TEMPLATES_MGMT.NO_INBOX_SELECTED: Select a WhatsApp inbox above to see its templates.

GUIDELINE.TITLE: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API quality and delivery guidelines
GUIDELINE.DESCRIPTION: Keep your quality rating High by sending relevant messages with explicit opt-in. Use custom variables and action buttons to improve your response rate.

LIST.RESULTS_COUNT: {count} message template shown | {count} message templates shown

REJECTED_REASON.TAG_CONTENT_MISMATCH: Category does not match the content
REJECTED_REASON.PROMOTIONAL: Promotional content in a category that does not allow it

MESSAGE_TEMPLATES_MGMT.FETCH_ERROR: We could not fetch the templates for this inbox.

STEP_1.TITLE: Choose a category
STEP_1.DESCRIPTION: The category determines what the template can be used for and how Meta reviews it.
STEP_1.META_GUIDELINE: Meta guideline: each category has its own rules and pricing on the WhatsApp Cloud API. Marketing messages require prior opt-in from recipients.
STEP_1.CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION: The category determines the purpose and Meta's sending rates.

INBOX.TITLE: Destination inbox
INBOX.DESCRIPTION: Choose which WhatsApp inbox and channel will receive and be able to send this template.

MARKETING.LABEL: Marketing
MARKETING.DESCRIPTION: Promotions, offers, announcements and other messages to engage or sell to customers. Requires prior opt-in.

UTILITY.LABEL: Utility
UTILITY.DESCRIPTION: Order updates, account alerts and other non-promotional messages tied to a specific customer action or transaction.

AUTHENTICATION.LABEL: Authentication
AUTHENTICATION.DESCRIPTION: One-time codes that let customers access their account, such as verification codes and one-time passwords.

SUBTYPES.TITLE: Select the type for {category}
SUBTYPES.DESCRIPTION: The type determines which fields are available in the template content.

STANDARD.LABEL: Standard
STANDARD.DESCRIPTION: Send messages with media and custom buttons to engage your customers.

CATALOG.LABEL: Catalog
CATALOG.DESCRIPTION: Send messages that drive sales by connecting your product catalog.

FLOWS.LABEL: Flows
FLOWS.DESCRIPTION: Send a form to collect customer interest, take appointment requests or run surveys.

ORDER_DETAILS.LABEL: Order details
ORDER_DETAILS.DESCRIPTION: Send messages customers can use to pay you.

CALL_PERMISSION_REQUEST.LABEL: Call permission request
CALL_PERMISSION_REQUEST.DESCRIPTION: Ask customers whether you may call them on WhatsApp.

SUBTYPES.AREA_BUTTONS: up to {count} action or quick reply button | up to {count} action or quick reply buttons

UTILITY_STANDARD.LABEL: Standard
UTILITY_STANDARD.DESCRIPTION: Send messages about an account or an existing order.

UTILITY_FLOWS.LABEL: Flows
UTILITY_FLOWS.DESCRIPTION: Send a form to collect feedback, send reminders or manage orders.

AUTHENTICATION_STANDARD.LABEL: One-time passcode
AUTHENTICATION_STANDARD.DESCRIPTION: Send codes to verify a transaction or a login.

ORDER_STATUS.LABEL: Order status
ORDER_STATUS.DESCRIPTION: Send messages to keep customers informed about the progress of their orders.

NAME.LABEL: Template name
NAME.HINT: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only.

HEADER.TITLE: Header (optional)
HEADER.UPLOAD_ERROR: We could not upload the file.

BODY.LABEL: Body
BODY.PLACEHOLDER: Write your message. Use {'{'}{'{'}1{'}'}{'}'} , {'{'}{'{'}2{'}'}{'}'} ... to add variables.
BODY.AUTH_HINT: Meta defines the body content for Authentication templates and it cannot be edited. Only the sample code value is customizable.

VARIABLE_TYPE.LABEL: Variable type
VARIABLE_TYPE.TOOLTIP: Variables are placeholders used to dynamically insert information into your template. You can use a name or a number as a variable. Examples: Name: {'{'}{'{'}order_id{'}'}{'}'} Number: {'{'}{'{'}1{'}'}{'}'}
VARIABLE_TYPE.NAMED_HINT: Edit each variable's name directly in the text, e.g. {'{'}{'{'}customer_name{'}'}{'}'}.

VARIABLES.TITLE: Sample values for variables
VARIABLES.DESCRIPTION: Meta uses these samples to review your template. They are not sent to customers.

BUTTONS.TITLE: Buttons
BUTTONS.DESCRIPTION: Add buttons that let customers reply to your message or take an action. You can add up to {count} buttons.
BUTTONS.FIXED_TEXT_HINT: Meta sets this button's text automatically and it cannot be changed.
BUTTONS.MAX_REACHED: You have reached the limit of {count} buttons.

FIELDS.URL_VARIABLE_SAMPLE_PLACEHOLDER: Full URL, with a real value instead of {'{'}{'{'}1{'}'}{'}'}
FIELDS.FLOW_CREATE_HINT: Creates and publishes a Flow on this account without leaving this page. You can edit it later in WhatsApp Manager.
FIELDS.FLOW_CREATE_ERROR: We could not create the Flow on this account.
FIELDS.FLOWS_EMPTY: No Flows on this account. Create one in WhatsApp Manager and publish it.
FIELDS.FLOWS_NONE_PUBLISHED: This account has Flows, but none published. Publish one in WhatsApp Manager to use it here.
FIELDS.FLOWS_ERROR: We could not load the Flows for this account.
FIELDS.NAVIGATE_SCREEN_HINT: Filled in automatically when you create the Flow here.
FIELDS.FLOW_ID_HINT: ID of a Flow already published in WhatsApp Manager.

PREVIEW.TITLE: Live preview
PREVIEW.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: Write the message body to see the preview.
PREVIEW.LIVE_NOTE_DESCRIPTION: Every change to the text, header, variables and buttons shows up instantly on the phone beside it.

VALIDATION.NAME_FORMAT: The name must contain only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores
VALIDATION.BODY_DANGLING_VARIABLE: A variable can't start or end the message body — it must sit in the middle of the text

CONFIRM.TITLE: Confirm template submission
CONFIRM.SUBTITLE: Review the summary below before submitting the template

CREATE.ERROR_MESSAGE: We could not submit the template.

EDIT.TITLE: Edit {name}
EDIT.NOT_EDITABLE: Only approved, rejected or paused templates can be edited
EDIT.DESCRIPTION: Editing replaces the template's entire content and submits it to Meta for review again. Name, language and category cannot be changed here.
EDIT.SUCCESS_MESSAGE: Template updated and resubmitted for Meta review.
EDIT.ERROR_MESSAGE: We could not update the template.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete template

CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete this template?
CONFIRM.MESSAGE: This cannot be undone. If the template is approved, you will not be able to reuse this name for 30 days.

DELETE.ERROR_MESSAGE: We could not delete the template.
